title: Socio Economic Expert_ BID Position
description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
   

  

 Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
   

  

 Context
   

  

 In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.
   

  

 Our unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Our fully integrated services are tailored to plan and manage projects using proven best practices.
   

  

 SYSTRA’s urban planning work is based on an integrated vision of mobility. We assess all relevant issues right from the start of project development, including current and future travel requirements, urban planning, economic and social development, and environmental protection.
   

  

 SYSTRA has completed 17,000\+ Square kilometer of Statutory Master Planning and 15\+ City Development Plans (CDPs).
   

  

 We are seeking applications for the position of Socio\-Economic Expert for Upcoming Urban Planning Project.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Conduct socio\-economic profiling of the project area, including population characteristics, employment patterns, income levels, housing conditions, education, and social infrastructure.
* Analyze social and economic development indicators to support planning interventions.
* Design and implement household surveys, socio\-economic surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
* Develop survey methodologies, questionnaires, and sampling framework.
* Analyze population trends, growth patterns, migration characteristics, and demographic structures.
* Prepare population projections and demographic forecasts.
* Provide socio\-economic inputs for preparation of Master Plans, Development Plans, Regional Plans, and Urban Development Strategies.
* Support land use planning, housing assessments, livelihood studies, and infrastructure planning through socio\-economic analysis.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Minimum 10 years of professional experience in socio\-economic studies, demographic analysis, and field surveys.
* Post Graduate Degree in Statistics, or Sociology, or Economics, or Geography, or Demography.
* Strong knowledge of socio\-economic research methodologies and survey techniques.
* Expertise in demographic analysis and population forecasting.
* Proficiency in statistical analysis and data interpretation.


 We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job \- it’s a career!
   

  

 Workplace Type
   

  

 On\-site

title: Analyst- Materials Management
description:
**Company Overview**
 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Overview**
 As an Analyst – Materials Management, you will use supply\-chain knowledge, data management, and analytical skills to improve inbound raw\-material flow, availability, and network effectiveness across the assigned Operating Unit (OU). You will work as an individual contributor with Consultants, Assistant Managers, Plant Associate Managers, plant planners, and cross\-functional stakeholders. This role requires you to operate in 1\.30 pm to 10\.30 pm shift.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Support OU\-level performance improvement across OTD, DOS, VN, NPW, utilization, MDRs, lead\-time compliance, and related supply\-chain metrics.
* Prepare and maintain OU\-level analysis, and issue summaries for review with Consultants and Assistant Managers.
* Coordinate with Plant Associate Managers, plant planners, sourcing, transportation, suppliers, buyers, and other stakeholders to validate issues, document root causes, and track action closure.
* Support disruption recovery and escalation management by expediting materials, coordinating alternate sources of supply and transportation, reviewing purchase order commitments, and tracking recovery actions through closure. Identify recurring MDR issues, recommend practical corrective actions, and support sustainable solutions to improve supply continuity and reduce repeat disruptions.
* Support TLC and related supply\-chain analyses, including freight cost, safety stock, min–max levels, load efficiency, and less\-than\-truckload (LTL) optimization, to identify cost and service improvement opportunities.
* Assist with escalation tracking, process\-improvement initiatives, and the application of AI\-enabled tools and insights to improve decision\-making, generate cost improvement opportunities, and deliver measurable cost avoidance.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Full\-time graduation from an accredited university is required.
* Minimum 4 years of related experience in supply chain, materials management, planning, procurement, logistics, or a closely related field.
* Working knowledge of supply\-chain concepts, material planning, inventory concepts, and inbound\-material processes.
* Ability to gather, manage, analyze, and translate data into actionable information.
* Basic to intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and charts or graphs.
* Experience working with SAP Materials Management or a comparable enterprise resource\-planning system.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks, meet deadlines, manage commitments, and work effectively in a collaborative environment.
* Effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, with a proactive and solution\-oriented approach.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Full\-time master’s degree from an accredited university, preferably in supply chain, operations, logistics, business, engineering, or a related discipline.
* Five or more years of relevant experience in supply chain, materials management, planning, procurement, logistics, or analytics.
* Experience supporting manufacturing plants or global supply\-chain teams.
* Experience with supply\-chain analytics, inventory recommendations, material\-disruption recovery, or continuous\-improvement initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder\-management, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to work through ambiguity.


**ELIGIBILITY**
 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Deep Researcher
description:
WorldQuant develops and deploys systematic financial strategies across a broad range of asset classes and global markets. We seek to produce high\-quality predictive signals (alphas) through our proprietary research platform to employ financial strategies focused on market inefficiencies. Our teams work collaboratively to drive the production of alphas and financial strategies – the foundation of a balanced, global investment platform.
   

  

 WorldQuant is built on a culture that pairs academic sensibility with accountability for results. Employees are encouraged to think openly about problems, balancing intellectualism and practicality. Excellent ideas come from anyone, anywhere. Employees are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and possess an attitude of continuous improvement.
   

  

 Our goal is to hire the best and the brightest. We value intellectual horsepower first and foremost, and people who demonstrate an outstanding talent. There is no roadmap to future success, so we need people who can help us build it.
   

  

**The Role**
 WorldQuant is seeking an exceptional individual to join as Quantitative Researcher (Deep Research).
   

  

 Research is at the core of WorldQuant. Through rigorous exploration and unconstrained thinking about how to apply data to the financial markets, our researchers are in constant search of new alphas. Researchers at WorldQuant employ tested processes seeking to identify high\-quality predictive signals that we believe are undiscovered by the wider market. These signals are mathematical expressions of data that are used as inputs in our quantitative models.
   

  

**As Part Of This Role, You Will**
* Build predictive signals using a structured and methodical research process combining fundamental knowledge, data exploration and quantitative analysis
* Become a domain expert on each fundamental topic you cover, identify key information drivers to target your research
* Stay updated on the latest advancements in AI and LLM research, identifying opportunities to integrate them into quantitative finance applications


**What You’ll Bring**
* Bachelor's (Hons), Master's or PhD degree in in a highly quantitative or highly analytical field e.g. Math, Physics, Computer Science or Financial Engineering from a leading university with excellent academic records are strongly preferred
* At least 2 years of relevant financial research experience
* Creative problem solver with a passion for experimentation and tackling unsolved challenges
* Strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, and quantitative modeling
* Strong interest in financial markets
* Proficiency in Python and C\+\+
* Knowledge and hands\-on experience in AI, Machine Learning (ML), and LLMs is a plus
* Excellent communications skills (both written and oral English)

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Consultant - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
   

  

 You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open\-ended problem\-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand\-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI\-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
   

  

**THE WORK**
 Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
   

  

**Supply Chain AI Strategy \& Use Case Development**
* Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current\-state processes to AI\-enabled future states.
* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client\-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.
* Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain\-specific AI initiatives.


**Client Engagement \& Advisory Support**
* Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.
* Prepare client\-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.
* Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.


**Data \& AI Foundations**
* Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.
* Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.
* Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.
* Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous\-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

title: FTI Senior System Analyst (Oracle Hyperion, Tableau, AI)
description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward‑thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting‑edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long‑term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.
   

  

 From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.
   

  

**About The Department**
 About the department The Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) Technology team builds and operates the company’s Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) and reporting platforms that power planning, forecasting, cost allocation, profitability, and insight. Engineers, analysts, and product‑minded specialists partner with Global Finance and Technology, working in Agile sprints to prioritize backlogs and deliver releases. You will join a collaborative, high‑ownership environment with global exposure, modern Business Intelligence (BI) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools, and clear opportunities to deepen finance‑tech expertise and influence enterprise outcomes.
   

  

***How you will add value Platform ownership \& FP\&A enablement?***
**Key Responsibilities**
***EPM platform ownership \& FP\&A enablement:***
* Administer, configure, and enhance FP\&A/EPM platforms (security, metadata, hierarchies, models, versions, validations).
* Design and maintain planning and forecasting models within Adaptive Planning, supporting multiple different functions: Corporate and functional Opex; Headcount and compensation planning; Cost allocation and profitability by business line, investment platform, or legal entity.
* Design \& maintain reporting systems including Oracle Essbase – Multi‑Dimensional AUM (Assets Under Management) reporting; Power BI – Planning/Forecasting/AUM business‑intelligence dashboarding.
* Build and support dashboards and management reports leveraging Workday Office Connect and Oracle Smart View for Excel‑based reporting for FP\&A and Finance leadership.
* Administer and support Business Intelligence platforms (primarily Power BI), including user access, security, and platform maintenance
* Partner with Finance and Technology teams to resolve data, application and infrastructure issues impacting business processes

title: Senior Analyst Supply Chain Development
description:
The Senior Analyst, Supply Chain Development (SCD), plays a critical role in supporting Maersk's commercial growth agenda by identifying, quantifying, and designing innovative supply chain solutions for strategic customers. Working closely with Regional SCD Managers, Account Teams, Product Teams, and Customers, the role combines deep supply chain expertise, advanced analytics, and consultative problem\-solving to develop compelling value propositions that unlock customer value and drive profitable growth for Maersk.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

 Support Regional SCD teams in identifying customer growth opportunities and developing compelling Maersk logistics solutions in collaboration with cross\-functional sales pursuit teams.
   

  

 What you bring to this role
   

  

**Technical \& Analytical Execution**
* Lead complex analytical workstreams independently, leveraging customer data to develop analytical models, supply chain digital twins, and scenario\-based simulations supporting solution evaluation and optimization.
* Lead complex supply chain analyses and define the appropriate analytical approach, including Network optimization, Asset utilization, Transportation modelling, Inventory modelling \& optimization, and warehouse assessments.
* Analyze large and complex datasets to uncover trends, risks, inefficiencies, and actionable business insights and translate them into clear recommendations for customer and business decisions.
* Leverage AI capabilities, industry research, and emerging technologies to accelerate analysis, develop scenarios, and shape differentiated customer\-specific supply chain recommendations.
* Identify and develop new analytical methodologies, value propositions, and opportunities by leveraging AI and emerging technologies.
* Utilize analytical tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL, Python, AIMMS, and similar platforms to solve complex supply chain challenges and provide guidance on the appropriate analytical tools and methodologies.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of supply chain digital twins and simulation\-based modelling and apply these methodologies to complex customer challenges.
* Translate analytical findings into compelling executive presentations, dashboards, visualizations, and customer\-centric recommendations that influence business and commercial decisions.


**Commercial Opportunity Development**
* Own the analytical and solution development for selected customer opportunities, partnering with Regional SCD, Sales, Product, and other cross\-functional teams to develop compelling Maersk logistics solutions.
* Develop insight\-led value propositions that address customer pain points and deliver quantifiable business outcomes. including clear linkage to commercial and revenue opportunities.
* Engage directly with customers through discovery workshops, solution discussions, and business case presentations, acting as a trusted advisor on supply chain solutions and recommendations.
* Apply a holistic understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain operations to shape and design integrated customer solutions and strategic recommendations.
* Demonstrate strong commercial acumen by connecting analytical insights and solution recommendations to customer value, commercial outcomes, and Maersk revenue opportunities.


**Stakeholder Management \& Collaboration**
* Partner with Regional SCD, Product, Operations, and Sales teams to shape and drive customer solutions, influencing stakeholders across functions without direct authority.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders through proactive communication and expectation management acting as a trusted advisor to customers and senior stakeholders.
* Act as a bridge between regional commercial and analytical teams to ensure effective translation of customer requirements into solution designs.
* Coach, mentor, and guide Analysts during sales pursuits and support the onboarding and development of new team members.
* Act as a subject matter expert by defining and sharing best practices, coaching team members, and driving continuous improvement and standardization across projects.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of selected customer engagements, from problem definition and analytical approach through solution development, recommendation, and delivery.


 Desired Skills:
   

  

* Education \& Experience
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Science or any other similar discipline
* Work experience of 5\+ years in Logistics \& Supply Chain. Relevant customer facing experience of 4\+ years in supply chain consulting is mandatory.
* Technical \& Analytical Capabilities
* Experience working with supply chain analysis software like Coupa/Llamasoft Supply Chain Guru, AIMMS, Kinaxis, etc.
* Strong quantitative, research, data analytics, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to independently define analytical approaches for complex supply chain challenges.
* Working knowledge of MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Visio, Publisher)
* Knowledge of R/Python/Tableau is preferred
* Communication, Stakeholder \& Professional Skills
* Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and influencing skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders without authority.
* Ability to build trusted relationships and act as a credible advisor to customers and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to independently manage multiple priorities, take ownership of deliverables, and make recommendations with limited supervision.

title: Regulatory Reporting -Business Analyst
description:
Acies Technology Implementation Practice is seeking an experienced
 **Business Analyst – Regulatory Reporting** 
 to support regulatory reporting analysis and solution delivery across Acies product implementations for banks, NBFCs, financial institutions, and insurance companies in India and the Middle East.
 



  





**Highlight of the engagement opportunity**



* Nature of role: Full time
* Number of years of experience expected: 3–8 years of relevant experience, including at least 2–3 years in regulatory reporting, RegTech, or BFSI reporting implementation. Candidates without direct regulatory reporting implementation experience will not be shortlisted.
* Areas of past experience preferred / mandatory:
* Business analysis for regulatory reporting implementations in Banking, NBFC, Financial Institutions, or Insurance.
* Strong hands\-on experience with BRD, FSD, user stories, data mapping, gap analysis, traceability matrix, UAT, and reporting validation.
* Regulatory interpretation and translation of circulars/guidelines into functional and data requirements.
* Exposure to one or more of the following:
* India: RBI returns, NBFC regulatory returns, IRDAI reporting, Basel III/IV, IFRS 9, LCR, NSFR, ALM, capital adequacy, NPA/asset classification.
* Middle East: CBUAE, SAMA, CBB, QCB, CBO, CMA Kuwait, and other regional regulatory reporting frameworks.
* Experience with regulatory reporting platforms or automation tools such as AxiomSL, Wolters Kluwer OneSumX, Vermeg, SAS, Oracle OFSAA, Moody’s, or similar RegTech solutions.
* Strong data analysis skills using SQL and advanced Excel.
* Educational qualification required: Chartered Accountant / MBA / Master’s degree in Finance, Business, or related field.
* Additional certifications preferred: FRM, PRM, CFA, Basel/IFRS certification, SQL/data analytics certification.
* Preferred geography of previous work experience: India and/or Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, Kuwait).
* Language requirements: Ability to write and speak fluently in English. Arabic is an added advantage for Middle East projects.
* Technology proficiency preferred:
* Advanced MS Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint, Visio.
* SQL for data extraction, validation, and reconciliation.
* JIRA / Confluence or similar requirement and defect management tools.
* Regulatory reporting platforms: AxiomSL, OneSumX, Vermeg, SAS, OFSAA, Moody’s, or equivalent.
* Power BI / Tableau is a plus.



  





  





**Key responsibility areas:**





* Interpreting regulatory guidelines and circulars from regulators such as RBI, IRDAI, CBUAE, SAMA, CBB, QCB, CBO, CMA Kuwait, and others.
* Gathering and documenting business and functional requirements through BRD, FSD, user stories, process flows, and data mapping documents.
* Performing gap analysis between regulatory requirements, client processes, and existing systems.
* Defining data sourcing, transformation, validation rules, lineage, aggregation, and controls required for regulatory reports.
* Helping configure, test, and validate reporting outputs on Acies or third\-party regulatory reporting platforms.
* Supporting UAT, defect triage, reconciliation, audit trails, and final sign\-off.
* Working closely with client compliance, risk, finance, data, and IT teams to ensure accurate and timely regulatory submissions.
* Contributing to continuous improvement of reporting templates, automation, and delivery accelerators.
* Managing time\-bound regulatory deadlines with high attention to detail and quality.
* Communicate project updates to stakeholders and prepare regular status reports highlighting progress, challenges, and key milestones.
* Drive day‑to‑day execution of assigned client projects.
* Develop a strong understanding of the client’s business, strategic priorities, industry dynamics, and market conditions, and recommend/implement improvements that deliver ongoing value.


- 


  





**Other important information:**



* **Work permit requirements:** 
 Either Indian Citizen or having valid work permit to work in India
* **Period of engagement:** 
 Full\-time position
* **Probation period:** 
 6 months
* **Compensation:** 
 Compensation varies depending on the skill, fitment and role played by the person. Compensation discussions will take place post the selection process.
* **Performance incentives:** 
 Typically, all roles at Acies have a performance incentive. Specific aspects will be discussed during the compensation discussion
* **Leave:** 
 19 working days a year. Additional leaves for national holidays, sick leaves, maternity and paternity, bereavement and studies vary based on the city and country of engagement.
* **Other benefits:** 
 Other employment benefits including medical insurance will be informed during the compensation discussion.
* **Career growth for full\-time roles:** 
 Acies believes in a transparent and data\-based performance evaluation system. You are encouraged to clarify any questions you have with respect to career growth with Acies personnel you interact with during the selection process.
* **Career opportunities for part\-time roles:** 
 Conversion of part\-time roles to full\-time roles depends on both performance of the individual and business needs. You are encouraged to ask about the prospects as you interact with Acies personnel during the selection process.
* **Global mobility:** 
 Acies encourages mobility across our offices. Such mobility is, however, subject to business needs and regulations governing immigration and employment in various countries.



  





**Selection process:**




 We seek to be transparent during the selection process. While the actual process may vary from the process indicated below, the key steps involved are as follows:
 


* Domain / regulatory reporting interview: Assessment of regulatory reporting knowledge, BRD/FSD, data mapping, gap analysis, and UAT experience.
* Technical / data case study: SQL, data validation, reconciliation, and reporting logic exercise.
* Client / partner fit interview: Problem\-solving, communication, ownership, and ability to work with compliance, risk, finance, and IT stakeholders.
* Final discussion on career and compensation: Post final selection, a separate discussion will be set up to discuss compensation and career growth.
* The number of interview rounds may increase depending on the criticality and seniority of the role involved.



  





 For any additional queries you may have, you can send a LinkedIn InMail to us, connect with us at https://www.acies.consulting/contact\-us.php or e\-mail us at careers@acies.holdings.
 



  





**How to reach us:**




 Should you wish to apply for this job, please reach out to us directly through LinkedIn or apply on our website career page \- https://www.acies.consulting/careers\-apply.html

The role is responsible for developing, enhancing, and maintaining quantitative risk models and analytics that support the firm?s enterprise?wide risk framework, including capital, liquidity, credit, market, operational, and strategic risk assessments, as applicable. The role contributes to independent risk measurement, stress testing, and scenario analysis that inform senior management decision?making and support regulatory and internal risk governance requirements. The incumbent applies advanced quantitative techniques to design and implement robust, well?documented models, ensuring that model assumptions, methodologies, data, and outputs adhere to BNY?s model risk standards and Enterprise Risk Management policies. The role supports the BNY strategic pillars by enabling stronger risk?aware growth and operational resilience through high?quality, transparent risk metrics, and supports BNY?s principles by demonstrating accountability, good judgement, and client focus in the development and communication of risk analyses. The Senior Specialist, Risk Modeling collaborates with partners across Enterprise Risk Management, Model Risk Management, Finance, lines of business, and Engineering to ensure models are conceptually sound, implemented effectively, and continuously improved over time. The role emphasizes clear documentation, reproducible analytics, and the ability to articulate complex quantitative concepts in a concise and accessible way to risk, business, and control stakeholders. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES Develops and enhances quantitative risk models and analytical tools (e.g., for capital, liquidity, credit, market, or enterprise?wide risk measures) by applying advanced statistical, econometric, and mathematical techniques and ensuring alignment with Enterprise Risk Management frameworks and risk policies. Performs rigorous model performance monitoring, sensitivity analysis, and back?testing by designing and executing quantitative tests, analyzing outcomes, and recommending model refinements to maintain accuracy, stability, and regulatory compliance. Prepares high?quality model documentation, including model design, data sources, assumptions, limitations, and test results, by following established model governance and Enterprise Risk Management standards to support internal approvals, audits, and regulatory reviews. Contributes to enterprise stress testing and scenario analysis by translating macroeconomic and risk scenarios into model inputs, running simulations, and synthesizing results into clear risk insights for senior risk leaders and business partners. Partners with Model Risk Management, business, Finance, and Engineering teams by gathering requirements, explaining model methodologies and limitations, and responding to challenge and feedback to promote transparent, well?understood risk measures across the firm. Identifies opportunities to automate and industrialize recurring analytics and reporting by leveraging programming languages and data tools to build efficient, scalable processes that improve timeliness, control, and consistency of risk information. EDUCATION/QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor?s degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, econometrics, engineering, physics, computer science, finance, or related field required. Advanced degree (Master?s or PhD) in a quantitative discipline preferred. Strong background in quantitative methods, numerical analysis, and statistical or econometric modeling. Proficiency in one or more programming languages or analytical tools (e.g., Python, R, SAS, MATLAB, or similar) and experience working with large datasets preferred. EXPERIENCE Typically 4\-6 years of experience SKILLS Strong quantitative modeling and analytical skills, including experience with statistical/econometric techniques, validation concepts, and performance measurement for risk models. Proficiency in programming and data manipulation, with the ability to design, implement, and automate robust, reproducible quantitative analyses. Effective communication and documentation skills, with the ability to clearly explain model design, assumptions, limitations, and results to both technical and non?technical stakeholders."

title: Analyst
description:
**About Us**
 At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Analyst in the Financial Institutions Group (FIG), India, you will support the day\-to\-day management and growth of the FIG franchise through business analytics, management reporting, portfolio management, client intelligence, KYC coordination, and business governance activities. The role works closely with FIG bankers, product partners, risk, compliance, operations, and regional stakeholders to ensure efficient business management and high\-quality client support.
   

  

 This role provides an excellent foundation for building a career in Institutional Banking by offering exposure to financial institution clients, portfolio management, business strategy, governance processes, and the wider FIG business.
   

  

 Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
   

  

**Role Type: Permanent
   

  

 Role Location: Altimus, Pandurang Budhkar Marg, Worli
   

  

 Work Hours: Regular working hours**
**What will your day look like?**
 As an Analyst, you will have the opportunity to:
   

  

* Prepare and maintain regular management information reports, dashboards, and business performance packs.
* Monitor business metrics including revenues, pipelines, client activity, wallet opportunities, and portfolio trends.
* Track and update pipeline reports, deal trackers, and business development initiatives.
* Compile and analyse business data to support decision\-making and strategic planning.
* Maintain reporting databases and ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of management information
* Support preparation and maintenance of client account plans and relationship reviews.
* Conduct industry research and gather market intelligence on clients, sectors, and competitors.
* Prepare briefing notes and background materials for client meetings and senior management interactions.
* Coordinate customer onboarding, KYC reviews, sanctions screening, and customer due diligence requirements.
* Track KYC renewal timelines and ensure timely completion of documentation in accordance with ANZ policies and regulatory requirements.
* Assist with implementation of business initiatives, regulatory projects, and process improvement activities.
* Support preparation of presentations, management papers, business reviews, and leadership updates.


**What will you bring?**
 To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
   

  

* Graduate qualification in Commerce, Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.
* 2\-3 years of experience in banking. FIG/ Corp team experience will be beneficial
* Understanding of banking regulation and local market nuances.
* Understanding of the credit and documentation principles
* Ability to form effective working relationships with senior bankers, product partners and internal stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving ability, growth mindset and capacity to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Good verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear client materials and senior management updates
* High attention to detail and accuracy, particularly around pipeline, revenue, portfolio, KYC and transaction information


 You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**So why join us? (Global)**
 From the moment you join ANZ, you'll be doing meaningful work that will shape a world where people and communities thrive.
   

  

 But it's not just our customers who'll feel your impact. you'll feel it too. Because at ANZ, you'll have the resources, opportunities, and support you need to take the next big step in your career.
   

  

 We're a diverse bunch at ANZ in different roles, different locations, doing different things. That's why we have a range of flexible working arrangements, so our people can 'make work, work for them'. We also provide a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services and discounts on selected products and services from ANZ and more.
   

  

 At ANZ, you'll be part of an organisation where the different backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people are celebrated. That's because we're committed to building a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We welcome applications from everyone and encourage you to talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirement, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
   

  

 To find out more about working at ANZ, visit https://www.anz.com.au/careers. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 124185\.

description:

As an Data Collection Transformation Associate, you will be responsible for delivering on initiatives as part of the S\&C transformation agenda. * Unlock the Power of Information: Work with a vast array of data sources—including annual reports, company websites, quantitative data feeds, web crawlers, and news articles—to transform unstructured information into actionable intelligence.
* Revolutionize Data Collection with AI: Design and implement AI\-assisted, scalable models that streamline data sourcing from multiple channels, ensuring comprehensive coverage of issuers.
* Automate \& Scale Data Methodologies: Develop innovative, automation\-friendly data collection methodologies that convert unstructured data into structured insights through advanced AI\-driven “electronification.”
* Engineer Next\-Gen AI Models: Build and refine generative AI\-powered data extraction models, ensuring continuous improvement in accuracy, efficiency, and performance.
* Lead \& Optimize AI Agents: Manage, guide, and enhance AI agents, serving as a validation layer to improve outputs and refine AI\-generated insights through expert feedback.
* Shape the Future of Data Operations: Partner with technology and transformation teams to design, optimize, and engineer cutting\-edge data workflows and operational processes.
* Enhance Data Quality \& Efficiency: Drive automation initiatives that improve data quality diagnostics, reducing manual intervention and increasing operational efficiency
* Collaborate for Impact: Work closely with internal stakeholders and downstream teams to understand data needs, define quality control frameworks, and ensure seamless data delivery.
* Engage with Companies \& Clients: Review and process company feedback, address client queries, and contribute to a transparent, data\-driven ecosystem that powers critical decision\-making.

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Environmental Science, Data Science, or related interdisciplinary fields.
* 7–12 years of experience in large‑scale data collection, research, data operations, or supply‑chain analysis; climate or sustainability domain experience is an advantage.
* Experience of leading the projects to completion and working with stakeholders and team members
* Experience applying GenAI/LLMs for data extraction, summarization, classification, or workflow automation; ability to build prompt‑based workflows and evaluate model output.
* Familiarity with AI agents, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), or ML‑assisted quality is required.
* Hands‑on experience with Python for automation, web scraping, API integration, data cleaning, and high‑volume processing.
* Working knowledge of SQL and comfort handling large datasets.
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to interpret complex corporate disclosures and extract meaningful supply‑chain insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to work effectively with global teams across multiple time zones and collaborate with cross‑functional partners

All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride \& Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

title: Data Governance Analyst
description:
**Position Summary**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented
 **Data Governance Analyst** 
 to lead data quality and data integrity auditing activities across the enterprise. This role will be responsible for designing, executing, maintaining, and continuously improving data quality audits to ensure critical data assets remain accurate, complete, consistent, and compliant with established governance standards.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of master data, transactional data, reference data, and enterprise data ecosystems, along with the analytical skills required to identify trends, uncover risks, and communicate actionable insights to business stakeholders and data stewards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own, execute, and maintain enterprise data quality and data integrity audits across key data domains.
* Partner with Data Governance Leads and business stakeholders to identify data risks, define controls, and enhance audit methodologies.
* Continuously refine audit rules, thresholds, and monitoring criteria based on evolving business requirements and governance standards.
* Analyze audit results to identify trends, root causes, and emerging data quality risks.
* Develop meaningful metrics, scorecards, dashboards, and executive summaries to communicate findings.
* Present insights and recommendations to data stewards, data owners, and governance forums.
* Track remediation efforts and validate resolution of identified data quality issues.
* Support the implementation of data governance policies, standards, and controls.
* Collaborate with business and technology teams to improve data quality processes and prevent recurring issues.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3\-6 years of experience in Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Analytics, Master Data Management, or related disciplines.
* Strong understanding of:
+ Master Data
+ Transactional Data
+ Reference Data
+ Data Quality Management
+ Data Governance principles and controls

* Knowledge of distribution business processes and the challenges associated with multi\-system data environments.
* Understanding of Single Source of Truth (SSOT) concepts and enterprise data lifecycle management.
* Experience using BigQuery or similar data platforms and querying tools (SQL required).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and identify meaningful insights.
* Experience creating reports, dashboards, and presentations for business stakeholders.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


**Preferred Attributes**
* Strong attention to detail and investigative mindset.
* Ability to translate complex data findings into clear business recommendations.
* Comfortable working across business and technology teams.
* Passion for data quality, governance, and continuous process improvement.

title: Healthcare Revenue Cycle Analyst – 835/ERA & Cash Posting (Contract)
description:
**Company Description**
 At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next\-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start\-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
   

  

 Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self\-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
   

  

**Job Description**
**POSITION SUMMARY**
 The Receivables \& Billing Analyst is responsible for accurate cash posting, payment reconciliation, client billing, and revenue cycle support. This role ensures timely reconciliation of deposits, EFTs, and 835 remittances while investigating discrepancies, maintaining billing accuracy, and producing reporting that supports financial operations. The position requires strong analytical skills, advanced Excel proficiency, and the ability to work U.S. business hours to support cash wire transfer timelines.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Interpret ANSI 835 Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA) files and accurately match payments to claims.
* Post EFT, check, lockbox, and credit card payments to patient accounts.
* Reconcile unapplied cash balances and process adjustments and write\-offs accurately.
* Perform daily reconciliation of bank deposits, EFT transactions, and 835 remittances.
* Identify, investigate, and resolve payment and reconciliation variances.
* Monitor unapplied cash and move payments to the appropriate patient account and program.
* Generate, validate, and distribute client invoices.
* Review billing against client contracts and fee schedules and investigate discrepancies.
* Maintain billing audit trails and supporting documentation.
* Develop reconciliation reports, exception tracking, and data validation reporting.
* Utilize advanced Excel functions including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, conditional formatting, and reconciliation techniques.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to resolve billing and payment issues.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**Required Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
**Technical Competencies**
* 835/ERA expertise
* Cash posting experience
* Client billing knowledge
* Advanced Microsoft Excel
* Daily reconciliation experience


**Critical Thinking Competencies**
* Problem solving
* Analytical reasoning
* Investigative mindset
* Attention to detail


**Investigative \& Analytical Expectations**
* Determine why financial records do not balance.
* Research missing transactions, timing differences, duplicate postings, and incorrect payment applications.
* Analyze bank reports, EFT confirmations, 835 files, and client invoices to resolve discrepancies.
* Ensure accuracy of payment amounts, check numbers, deposit dates, account numbers, and adjustment codes.


**WORK HOURS**
 This position is expected to work U.S.\-based business hours to support cash wire transfer timelines and daily financial operations.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Healthcare Administration, or related field preferred.
* Experience in accounts receivable, billing, cash posting, revenue cycle, or healthcare finance.
* Experience working with 835/ERA remittances and payment reconciliation preferred.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Additional Information**
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e\-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
   

  

 From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long\-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market\-leading businesses and meaningful careers.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
 With 19\.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben \& Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
   

  

 We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
   

  

**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
 We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
   

  

 We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
   

  

 The role
   

  

 As a Finance Junior Manager gives support to the (alternatively) Materials / Factory / Logistics / Supply Chain Overheads and Business Waste respective teams by performing various day to day operational activities for them, discussing, and sharing relevant information and assumptions behind these activities so that European finance teams and countries can concentrate on their core business partnering tasks.
   

  

 What you'll be responsible for
   

  

 Ensure Knowledge transfer is OTIF from old SCFS Teams in Unilever ahead of the end of the TSA (Temporary Service Agreement) by end 2026\.
   

  

 Act as first point of contact for the respective Cost Bucket Owners in Europe and all its countries and factories covering localization process of Opus Design (New SAP) representing EU processes,
   

  

 Being the linking pin between the internal Cost Buckets Owners and the team members in charge of transfer pricing and intercompany flows
   

  

 Coordinate the Business Plan \& Quarterly TP update processes between GBS team and 3rd party subcontractors where applicable
   

  

 Facilitate the Transfer Price corrections and strengthen the controls process identifying together with Unilever SCFS the root causes
   

  

 Deliver understanding \& transparency of Supply Chain cost developments (Actuals vs. Forecast) for the Cost Bucket in scope
   

  

 Maintain and develop various TP reporting using relevant tools (Power BI, Power Query etc.)
   

  

 Lead projects for further development of the analytical support provided to the external stakeholders
   

  

 Lead projects for continuous improvement in team processes
   

  

 We're looking for someone who
   

  

 University degree in Finance (minimum Bachelor)
   

  

 Minimum of 4 years of finance working experience preferably in finance business partnering
   

  

 Excellent MS Excel Skills. Power BI/ Power Query is required.
   

  

 Effective Communication: Fluent in English, oral and written.
   

  

 Analytical thinking, problem solving attitude.
   

  

 Financial Accounting and Reporting knowledge
   

  

 Effective Prioritization and Problem\-solving attitude
   

  

 Forward looking approach and ability to provide “what if” analysis
   

  

 Multiple Stakeholders Management
   

  

 IT skills – excellent level of computer literacy (incl excel \& SAP)
   

  

 Motivation to build up own agenda
   

  

 Team working – demonstrate commitment to the team in helping to achieve goals; proactively share best practice, ideas and insights with colleagues
   

  

 Agility and ability to adjust quickly to the changes
   

  

 What you'll get
   

  

 Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes
   

  

 Market\-competitive pay and performance related rewards
   

  

 Flexible ways of working
   

  

 Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work
   

  

 Time off to rest and recharge
   

  

 Ongoing learning and development opportunities
   

  

 Specific benefits vary by location
   

  

**Why join us?**
 This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed \- both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end\-to\-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
   

  

 You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy \- and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
   

  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.


 Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
   

  

**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
 If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
   

  

 If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

 Master's Degree

* SAP HANA Information Models Development: Exposure to designing, developing, and managing S/4HANA and/or SAP HANA Information Models, including hands\-on experience with SQL Script, PL/SQL, Stored Procedures, Function Calls, and CDS views.
* HANA View Creation: Experience working with Attribute, Analytical, and Calc Views, and testing with BI Reporting tools to ensure seamless data integration and analysis.
* Data Management: Exposure to designing tables, managing data loads, and ensuring efficient data processing and storage.
* SAP HANA Technical Skills: Experience working with one or more of the following skills: SAP HANA Modelling, SAP HANA SQL, SAP HANA XSJS, SAP S4 HANA Modelling, SAP HANA SQL, SAP HANA SLT, and S/4 HANA Embedded Analytics.
* Technical Solution Delivery: Exposure to collaborating with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver tailored solutions that meet business needs, utilizing technical expertise in SAP HANA Analytics.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* SAP HANA Modelling Expertise: Exposure to SAP HANA Modelling, with the ability to design and implement data models that meet business requirements. Proficiency in creating and managing SAP HANA Information Models, including data loads and table design.
* Advanced HANA View Creation: Experience working with complex HANA Views, including Attribute, Analytical, and Calc Views, and testing with BI Reporting tools to ensure seamless data integration and analysis.
* SAP HANA XSJS Knowledge: Exposure to SAP HANA XSJS, with the ability to develop and deploy XSJS applications that interact with SAP HANA databases.

title: Operations Associate
description:
**About Skydo:** 




  





 Behind every Indian business going global is money they worked hard to earn. But when it’s time to get paid, they wait days and lose
 **3–7% of their revenue** 
 to hidden forex markups and fees nobody explains, just to receive what’s already theirs.
 



  





 We’re fixing this. Skydo gives exporters flat fees, zero forex markup, settlement in hours, and compliance that’s handled for them from start to finish.
 



  





**Join us and help millions of ambitious businesses get paid the way they deserve.** 




  





**About the Job:** 




  





 Skydo is looking for a Payment Operations Associate to support payment processing, reconciliations, and operational excellence across domestic and international banking partners.
 



  





**What you will do:** 




  





**01 Daily Payment Operations:** 




  




* Diligently execute Ops SOPs: payment processing, invoicing, tracking, documentation, and forex conversion operations with different bank partners, ensuring timely payment flow and SLA adherence.
* Manage and resolve operations tickets within defined SLAs with utmost diligence and customer centricity.
* Coordinate with customer\-facing and compliance teams to manage customer escalations and resolve tickets and customer dependencies.



  





**02 Reconciliation and Reporting:** 




  




* Maintain and enhance existing SQL dashboards by making modifications as required, and develop new dashboards when needed.
* Support and improve automated reconciliation processes for foreign and Indian banking partners.
* Generate and publish daily reports and keep track of KPIs for all banking partners and customer cohorts.
* Present periodic performance insights and drive accountability through data\-driven reporting.



  





**03 Analysis, Strategy and Process Improvement:** 




  




* Analyse the transaction data to identify trends, recurring issues and operational risks
* Recommend and implement process improvements and automations to reduce errors and turnaround time



  





**You’re a good fit if you have:** 




  




* 2–4 years of work experience in a professional operations environment.
* A highly ethical, values\-driven, proactive, growth\-oriented, and ambitious individual who thrives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Highly disciplined, punctual, and responsible, with the ability to manage the timely execution of high\-value payments.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand, own, and improve operational metrics.
* Experience with SQL is required, along with the ability to work with internal and external partners to drive operational performance.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with proficiency in both English and Hindi.
* Diligence and process orientation, and understanding of process linkage to KPIs



  





**The mindset we’re seeking:** 




  




* You’re comfortable working with dashboards, reports, and data to track performance and improve day\-to\-day operations.
* You enjoy solving operational problems, spotting gaps, and driving processes to closure with minimal supervision.

title: Data Integration & Migration Manager (D365 F&SC)
description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.
   

  

 We are looking for a Data Integration \& Migration professional with experience working within a team setting to design, deploy, and support technical solutions, with a primary focus on D365 Finance \& Supply Chain (F\&SC) data migration and application integration.
   

  

**The Team**
 You will be working with a national team with a client base that extends across the United States, many of which have a global footprint. Our Data Integration \& Migration team members have served in both consulting and industry roles and specialize in helping organizations deploy repeatable, scalable, and sustainable solutions that save time and resources. Our team is focused on ERP, CRM, and other Business Application data migrations and integrations from and to one or many different applications, with a strong emphasis on D365 F\&SC implementations, upgrades, and integrations.
   

  

 We have experienced rapid growth and maintain a strong pipeline of interesting and challenging projects. Our team is constantly looking for ways to evolve our delivery methods, technical solutions, and client capabilities through certifications and regular training. Team members are expected to contribute to these efforts in addition to client delivery responsibilities.
   

  

 Our team strives to be first\-choice advisors and well\-rounded professionals. We value collaboration, innovation, and inclusion, and we focus on maintaining a healthy work\-life balance while meeting client commitments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with client business, data, technical, project management, and partner teams to deliver complex D365 F\&SC data migration and integration engagements
* Lead data migration and application integration workstreams for D365 Finance \& Supply Chain programs, including data extraction, transformation, loading, validation, reconciliation, and end\-to\-end integration with upstream and downstream systems
* Document scope, assumptions, dependencies, estimates, and timelines using discovery sessions, workshops, interviews, and data profiling
* Assit in drafting Statements of Work (SOWs) and serve as a key point of contact for client stakeholders and executive sponsors
* Define data mappings, transformation rules, reference data, and data lineage across source systems and D365 F\&SC target models
* Work with data in normalized and dimensional models to support migration, reconciliation, and reporting needs
* Design, build, and demonstrate technical solutions using technologies such as:
* Data Management Framework (DMF)
* Dual\-write and Dataverse
* Azure Data Factory (ADF)
* Azure SQL Database / SQL Server
* T\-SQL
* Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI)
* Integration patterns using REST APIs, OData, and iPaaS platforms (Boomi, Informatica, etc.)
* Azure DevOps, GitHub, Atlassian Jira
* Lead data validation, reconciliation, testing strategies, and cutover planning
* Triage and resolve defects, manage QA cycles, and support user acceptance testing
* Be open to supporting other project types, learning new technologies, and broadening skillsets


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or graduate degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
* Experience leading data migration and integration efforts for F\&SC
* Hands\-on experience with D365 F\&SC Data Management Framework (DMF)
* Experience integrating D365 F\&SC with upstream and downstream systems
* Experience building and validating data models aligned to D365 F\&SC entities
* Minimum of 6 years in a data\-focused role
* At least 2 years of experience leading teams or workstreams
* Relevant technical certifications (Boomi, Microsoft, Azure, data/integration tools)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Understanding of D365 Finance and Supply Chain functional areas (GL, AP, AR, FA, Procurement, Inventory, Order\-to\-Cash, Record\-to\-Report)
* Understanding of D365 F\&SC data entities, tables, and extensibility concepts
* Experience with data migration tooling, templates, and repeatable frameworks for D365
* Experience with dual\-write, Dataverse, and Power Platform integrations
* Experience developing and consuming REST/OData APIs for D365 F\&SC
* Experience with data reconciliation, financial balancing, and audit support during ERP migrations
* Familiarity with reporting and analytics in D365 F\&SC and Power BI


 At RSM, we offer a competitive benefits and compensation package for all our people. We offer flexibility in your schedule, empowering you to balance life’s demands, while also maintaining your ability to serve clients. Learn more about our total rewards at https://rsmus.com/careers/india.html.
   

  

 RSM does not tolerate discrimination and/or harassment based on race; colour; creed; sincerely held religious beliefs, practices or observances; sex (including pregnancy or disabilities related to nursing); gender (including gender identity and/or gender expression); sexual orientation; HIV Status; national origin; ancestry; familial or marital status; age; physical or mental disability; citizenship; political affiliation; medical condition (including family and medical leave); domestic violence victim status; past, current or prospective service in the Indian Armed Forces; Indian Armed Forces Veterans, and Indian Armed Forces Personnel status; pre\-disposing genetic characteristics or any other characteristic protected under applicable provincial employment legislation.
   

  

 Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process and/or employment/partnership. RSM is committed to providing equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, interview, or otherwise participate in the recruiting process, please send us an email at careers@rsmus.com.

title: Associate - ISGI
description:
**Position Overview**
**ABOUT APOLLO**
 Apollo is a high\-growth, global alternative asset manager. In our asset management business, we seek to provide our clients excess return at every point along the risk\-reward spectrum from investment grade to private equity with a focus on three investing strategies: yield, hybrid, and equity. For more than three decades, our investing expertise across our fully integrated platform has served the financial return needs of our clients and provided businesses with innovative capital solutions for growth. Through Athene, our retirement services business, we specialize in helping clients achieve financial security by providing a suite of retirement savings products and acting as a solutions provider to institutions. Our patient, creative, and knowledgeable approach to investing aligns our clients, businesses we invest in, our employees, and the communities we impact, to expand opportunity and achieve positive outcomes.
   

  

**OUR PURPOSE AND CORE VALUES**
 Our Clients Rely On Our Investment Acumen To Help Secure Their Future. We Must Never Lose Our Focus And Determination To Be The Best Investors And Most Trusted Partners On Their Behalf. We Strive To Be
   

  

 The leading provider of retirement income solutions to institutions, companies, and individuals.
   

  

 The leading provider of capital solutions to companies. Our breadth and scale enable us to deliver capital for even the largest projects – and our small firm mindset ensures we will be a thoughtful and dedicated partner to these organizations. We are committed to helping them build stronger businesses.
   

  

 A leading contributor to addressing some of the biggest issues facing the world today – such as energy transition, accelerating the adoption of new technologies, and social impact – where innovative approaches to investing can make a positive difference.
   

  

 We are building a unique firm of extraordinary colleagues who:
   

  

 Outperform expectations
   

  

 Challenge Convention
   

  

 Champion Opportunity
   

  

 Lead responsibly
   

  

 Drive collaboration
   

  

 As One Apollo team, we believe that doing great work and having fun go hand in hand, and we are proud of what we can achieve together.
   

  

**Our Benefits**
 Apollo relies on its people to keep it a leader in alternative investment management, and the firm’s benefit programs are crafted to offer meaningful coverage for both you and your family. Please reach out to your Human Capital Business Partner for more detailed information on specific benefits.
   

  

**Team Overview**
 ISGI (Insurance Solutions Group International) provides investment advice and solutions to EMEA based insurance companies and portfolio companies. This investment management and advice is regulated in multiple jurisdictions. ISGI provides services on Strategic Asset Allocations (SAA) for client balance sheets, portfolio management through its Balance Sheet Management (BSM) pillar, Asset Liability Management (ALM), and allocates to Return Seeking (RS) private assets in line with SAA.
   

  

 ISGI leverages the strength and breadth of the Apollo platform to support and service its’ insurance clients.
   

  

**The Role**
 The role will focus on supporting portfolio analytics and reporting while playing an integral part in enhancing Quant capabilities. The successful candidate will work closely with senior team members on Quant\-related analytics and projects. They will also support the ISGI Investment Teams in London \& Zurich, ensuring data quality, building analytics, and contributing to the delivery of insights to help the investment team make informed decisions . It is also expected that from time\-to\-time, the role will support other functions within ISGI, as determined by client needs and team manager.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Develop and validate tools and controls to ensure the accuracy of risk analytics, data integrity, and reporting outputs
* Utilize existing proprietary model libraries for generating portfolio exposures, stress testing, risk metrics and performance attribution.
* Develop robust quantitative risk and stress models with analytical outputs that fully reflect the key risks of each position and meet the risk management objectives of portfolio managers and senior management.
* Build and enhance dashboards and visualizations using tools like PowerPoint and Excel.
* Streamline and automate reporting processes in collaboration with the technology team.
* Conduct detailed reviews of existing models and propose solutions to enhance the model output.
* Effectively communicate complex ideas to a range of stakeholders while building and maintaining strong internal and external relationships


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 3\+ years of experience as a Quant in a Front Office Pricing team in large Investment Banks or Asset Managers. A few years of this experience (but not all) could be in a model validation team validating front office models.
* Ability to perform under pressure and multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent analytical skills, rigorous, detailed\-oriented.
* Experience working with large datasets and a strong aptitude for data analysis.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as VBA, SQL, or Python.
* Bachelors or Master’s degree in disciplines such as mathematics, computer science, financial engineering.
* Practical and hands\-on experience in financial markets.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively and independently across different businesses and functional areas with thorough attention to detail in a potentially high paced environment.
* Must have strong drive and initiative, be collaborative to effectively liaise with senior stakeholders and colleagues.
* A forward thinking, creative individual who challenges the status quo and takes initiative to reengineer processes.
* Strong project management skills.
* Be nimble and flexible to balance multiple tasks simultaneously.
* The ability to take on a task and “run with it” to conclusion is a critical characteristic of this role.


*Apollo provides equal employment opportunities regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, veteran status, gender/sex or sexual orientation, or any other criterion or circumstance protected by applicable law, ordinance, or regulation. The above criteria are intended to be used as a guide only – candidates who do not meet all the above criteria may still be considered if they are deemed to have relevant experience/ equivalent levels of skill or knowledge to fulfil the requirements of the role. Any job offer will be conditional upon and subject to satisfactory reference and background screening checks, all necessary corporate and regulatory approvals or certifications as required from time to time, and entering into definitive contractual documentation satisfactory to Apollo.*

title: Commercial Capabilities Analyst
description:

 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

 We are building next\-generation sales capabilities through connected data, using retailer and syndicated sources to deliver reporting and analytics for the Noth America Retail Sales organization. As a Commercial Capabilities Analyst, you will coordinate business logic, technical requirements, and analysis to support solution development by technical teams. You will partner with Sales, e\-commerce, and other stakeholders to deliver robust reporting solutions, act as the champion for the Reporting Pod, and guide data, process, and enhancement efforts. You will work across Run, Operate, and Transform initiatives, providing technical consultation, writing tests, and building automation to improve efficiency and quality. The role requires strong communication, problem\-solving, and collaboration skills, along with the ability to work independently on large enterprise projects and mentor others with technical expertise.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Partner with teams across Sales, Ecommerce and Operating Units business partners to provide consultation and deliver robust technical solutions.
* Deliver Reporting Pod outcomes by bringing together multiple data sources to create a holistic reporting plan for Sales teams.
* Act as the champion and shepherd for all Reporting Pod activities, including data, process, and enhancements.
* Work with cross\-functional teams, including Analysts, Data Engineers, PMs, BI Developers, Solutions Architects, and business stakeholders, on business\-value\-driven projects.
* Support Run, Operate, and Transform initiatives across the full lifecycle.
* Provide technical consultation on data and processes to support business partners.
* Write unit and integration tests and develop automation tools for daily tasks.
* Challenge ideas and assumptions to avoid pitfalls and inefficient solutions.
* Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of solutions.
* Build and sustain strong relationships with stakeholders to support product strategy and data deliverables.
* Serve as a data expert for commercial data teams by understanding key business use cases and providing thoughtful analysis and recommendations.
* Learn complex business processes, operations, and strategy to effectively communicate and collaborate with stakeholders.
* Gather project requirements from downstream teams, translate them into technical documentation, and communicate throughout the development process.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Education – Full\-time graduation from an accredited university
* Minimum years of experience required is 3\-5 years in Analytics.
* Experience with Big Query and experience with writing SQL queries.
* Ability to learn complex business processes, operations, and strategy to effectively communicate and collaborate with stakeholders
* Excellent communication skills and ability to effectively communicate with technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Good understanding of agile methodologies and practices to assist with managing timelines and task prioritization


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Understanding of Google Cloud platform and its best practices, standards, tools, and documentation for analytical technologies
* Understanding of Sales data sets, POS data across different customers.
* Onboard and help other developers and analysts on the team.
* Provide insights and recommendations on business process or solution improvements.
