 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Quantitative Researcher
description:
IMC is looking for an experienced Quantitative Researcher to develop trading signals and predictive models for our Options business. If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with large datasets, and building models that drive trading performance, this role could be a great fit.
   

  

 You will focus on researching and developing statistically robust signals and models to better understand and predict options market behaviour. Your work will directly inform trading strategies and have a measurable impact on performance. You will also help shape the research direction by exploring new approaches and improving existing methodologies.
   

  

 IMC has strong advantages across market access, technology, and execution, and you will work in a collaborative environment alongside traders and engineers to translate research into production.
   

  

 Your Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and test alpha signals and predictive models for Indian options markets
* Perform large\-scale data analysis to uncover patterns and trading opportunities
* Apply rigorous statistical methods to ensure robustness and reliability of results
* Build a deep understanding of market behaviour, pricing dynamics, and structural inefficiencies
* Collaborate with traders and engineers to translate research into production strategies
* Continuously improve models and identify new areas of research


**Your Skills And Experience**
* 3\+ years of experience in quantitative research in NSE/BSE, ideally within derivatives or options
* Strong foundation in probability, statistics, and quantitative modelling
* Proven track record of developing impactful trading signals or models
* Experience working with large datasets and time\-series data
* Strong programming skills in at least one language (Python preferred)
* Curious, analytical mindset with a focus on problem\-solving and innovation


**About Us**
*IMC is a research\-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real\-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

title: Product Analyst
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Product Analyst supports the Product Team and their client business processes and operations by maintaining and enhancing existing products and creating new ones. This role requires a strong analytical mindset and technical expertise to work with large datasets, derive insights, and deliver value to stakeholders as well as product management and development experience. The Product Analyst combines operational, technical, and analytic skills with problem\-solving and communication abilities. You will collaborate with and work closely with Senior Data Analyst and/or Product Owner(s) to ensure successful project execution.
   

  

**Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:**
* Operational Execution:
+ Understand and communicate client business needs and issues, operating rules, data structures, and standard operating procedures.
+ Execute and suggest improvements to pre\-defined operational procedures.
+ Implement process improvement in operational workflows, working with Senior Data Analysts and Product Owners.
+ Assist Product Owners to streamline the ideas to development processes, and the technical requirements processes.

* Product Development:
+ Enhance and maintain data products by understanding the data, product(s)/offering(s), client needs, and business goals.
+ Collaborate with stakeholders regarding business objectives.
+ Support product management with product development, and execution.
+ Partner with Product management to create, maintain and update roadmap documentation
+ Assist teams towards common objectives and document the solutions/decisions made.
+ Create technical requirements, user stories and test plans as part of an Agile methodological approach.

* Data Analysis:
+ Compare datasets / various inputs to ensure data quality and derive actionable insights.
+ Apply quality checks and validations to the product delivery, reporting results and elaborative summary for internal team and important stakeholders.

* Stakeholder collaboration:
+ Coordinate with stakeholders across different time zones to ensure smooth working within timelines.
+ Assist engineering teams with knowledge transfer and testing of new operational procedures and enhancements.
+ Facilitate knowledge transfer and overall product knowledge for engineering, Engagement and other teams.
+ Partner with stakeholders e.g. Engagement and Product Owners to understand client business needs and pain points with the intention to write user stories that address those needs.
+ Work closely with product team: Owners, developers and testers to ensure that written requirements are clearly stated, and comprehensive.

* Knowledge development:
+ Build subject matter expertise in operational processes, data tools, content, and necessary technology, and Scrum / Agile methodologies
+ Remain updated on tools, techniques, and working models to enhance processes.
+ Develop functional understanding of the product offering via the technology and deployment stack, to facilitate writing effective user stories, requirements and user acceptance criteria.

* Project Management:
+ Work on multiple client tasks simultaneously, strengthening analytical, task management, and communication skills.
+ Keep track of unplanned internal and clients’ tasks arising from any developments to existing or new products.
+ Maximize time management skills to balance workload in order to complete multiple deadline driven projects with a minimum of supervisory input.

* Coordinate meetings and prepare status update documentation / meetings for ongoing projects Research and Problem\-Solving
+ Conduct secondary research e.g. marketplace conditions, competitive environment, best practices to keep the product quality best\-in class while being able to address clients’ questions related to the same.
+ Coordinate and co lead design sessions to document feature requirements and guide stakeholders towards decision\-making.
+ Investigate issues and recommend solutions to improve processes.

title: Data Architect
description:
**About Advanced Energy**
 Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: AEIS), enables design breakthroughs and drives growth for leading semiconductor and industrial customers. Our precision power and control technologies, along with our applications know\-how, inspire close partnerships and innovation in thin\-film and industrial manufacturing. We are proud of our rich heritage, award\-winning technologies, and we value the talents and contributions of all Advanced Energy's employees worldwide.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Data Architect is a highly skilled data professional responsible for designing, developing, and implementing scalable data architecture solutions that support enterprise reporting, analytics, and business intelligence initiatives. Working within established enterprise architecture standards, this role translates business and technical requirements into practical data solutions that enable trusted, accessible, and high\-quality data across the organization.
   

  

 The Data Architect partners with business stakeholders, Data Product Managers, data engineers, and analytics teams to design and optimize data pipelines, data models, integrations, and analytical platforms. This role applies advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills to resolve complex data challenges, improve data accessibility and quality, and support the successful delivery of data and analytics initiatives.
   

  

 The position operates independently on complex assignments, contributes to larger transformation programs, and may lead small projects or data architecture workstreams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Data Solution Architecture
* Design scalable and maintainable data architecture solutions aligned with enterprise standards, business requirements, and analytics objectives.
* Translate business and functional requirements into logical and physical data models.
* Develop architecture approaches for data ingestion, transformation, storage, and consumption across cloud and on\-premise environments.
* Evaluate existing data environments and recommend improvements to support performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* Data Integration \& Engineering Support
* Design and support data integration solutions for SAP ECC, SAP BW, SAP S/4HANA, and other enterprise systems.
* Define data movement, transformation, and integration approaches using Azure\-based technologies.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to implement ETL/ELT frameworks and reusable design patterns.
* Support performance tuning and optimization of data pipelines and processing workloads.
* Data Modeling \& Analytics Enablement
* Develop logical, conceptual, and physical data models that support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases.
* Design Lakehouse and modern data platform structures consistent with enterprise architecture guidelines.
* Partner with analytics teams to ensure data structures effectively support Power BI and other reporting solutions.
* Recommend improvements to data accessibility, usability, and reporting effectiveness.
* Data Governance \& Quality
* Support enterprise data governance initiatives by incorporating data quality, lineage, metadata, and security requirements into solution designs.
* Collaborate with governance teams to promote data standards and best practices.
* Help identify and resolve data quality issues through effective architecture and design approaches.
* Ensure compliance with established security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Stakeholder Collaboration
* Partner with business stakeholders, Data Product Managers, and technical teams to understand requirements and deliver effective data solutions.
* Communicate architecture concepts and technical recommendations to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Provide guidance and consultation on data architecture best practices and solution alternatives.
* Build strong working relationships across global and cross\-functional teams.
* Project Leadership \& Continuous Improvement
* Lead data architecture activities for small projects or defined workstreams within larger transformation initiatives.
* Contribute to architecture reviews, design sessions, and technical decision\-making processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve data platform capabilities, development practices, and operational efficiency.
* Stay current with emerging technologies, cloud data platforms, and industry best practices.


**Essential**
**Required Skills \& Technical Expertise**
* Strong understanding of data architecture principles, data modeling techniques, and data integration methodologies.
* Experience designing and implementing cloud\-based data solutions within Azure environments.
* Hands\-on experience with
* Azure Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL)
* Azure Data Factory (ADF)
* Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2\)
* Power BI
* Knowledge of ETL/ELT design and implementation methodologies.
* Experience with data warehousing, Lakehouse architecture, and modern analytics platforms.
* Strong SQL development and performance optimization skills.
* Familiarity with SAP data structures and source systems including SAP ECC, SAP BW, and SAP S/4HANA.
* Ability to analyze and resolve complex data and integration challenges


**Experience**
**Essential**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline and 5\+ years of relevant experience, OR
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, analytics platforms, or related data management disciplines.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise data solutions supporting reporting, analytics, and business intelligence initiatives.
* Experience participating in cross\-functional project teams and collaborating with business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience working within Agile delivery environments.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with SAP extraction technologies including CDS Views, ODP, OData, or SAP Extractors.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Purview, Collibra, or similar data governance solutions.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Synapse Analytics, or other cloud data platforms.
* Domain knowledge in Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, or Commercial Operations.
* Professional certifications related to Azure Data, Databricks, SAP Data \& Analytics, or Data Architecture.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently on complex assignments with limited supervision.
* Effective stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Collaborative approach with a focus on practical and business\-oriented solutions.
* Continuous learning mindset and commitment to technology innovation.


**Work Environment**
* Works in a standard office environment utilizing standard office equipment.
* Collaborates with global and cross\-functional teams.
* Works both independently and as part of a project team.
* May occasionally work outside standard business hours to support project requirements.
* Domestic and international travel may be required based on business needs.

title: Consultant - Demand Planning
description:
**Company Overview**
 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Overview**
 The fundamental purpose of this role is to drive improvement in forecast accuracy by optimizing the business processes, collaborating with business stakeholders and provide insights to the business partners (Regional Demand planners) to enhance business decisions and to support optimal service level for South East and Middle East Asian markets. This role requires you to operate in 11\.00 am to 8\.00 pm shift.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Manage forecasting and replenishment activities by maintaining accurate Sales and Stock Upload and IMS Forecast uploads, validating statistical forecasts in OMP, running Distributor Replenishment Planning and Sell\-In/Sell\-Out models, reconciling inventory gaps, and generating bottom\-up shipment plans.
* Partner with Demand Managers and distributors to develop the consensus demand plan, capture assumptions, enrich forecasts with market intelligence, analyze cycle\-over\-cycle changes, and identify risks, opportunities, and trend shifts.
* Maintain planning\-system and master\-data integrity by ensuring accurate Stock Keeping Unit and item\-planning setup, new product launches, delistings, Product Life Cycle updates, forecast volumes, control\-model and Sell\-In/Sell\-Out inputs, and timely SharePoint requests.
* Support the Sales and Operations Planning cycle by preparing Demand Review pre\-work, In\-Market Sales, Shipments, and Inventory analyses, building\-block summaries, Key Performance Indicator reports, assumption tracking, and version\-controlled monthly reporting.
* Track forecast accuracy, bias, stock availability, ageing, order\-versus\-plan, and supply\-chain Key Performance Indicators; perform root\-cause analysis for shipment forecast errors and communicate data\-driven recommendations with strong ownership, collaboration, attention to detail, and problem\-solving skills.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Education: Full Time graduation from an accredited university
* Experience: 3 years of related experience in demand planning
* Technical Skills: Operations and Demand planning process, Excel, Planning systems (like OMP/SAP/O9 etc)
* Soft Skills: Critical thinking, learning agility, ability to work in ambiguous situations and different markets, strong communication and stakeholder management.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s Degree
* Major area of study in operations
* Professional Certification – CSCMP/APICS etc

 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Salesforce Technical Manager - Core Data
description:
**Description**
 Salesforce is currently seeking a Manager, Technical Consulting to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. Our Manager, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in managing, training, and building the careers of our technical consulting team.
   

  

 In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our Core Data practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team.
   

  

 This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a Data Architect to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s platform and core data fundamentals.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* You will be required to deliver technical work (as a data/technical architect) on billable projects at 50% utilization and balance that with leading your team of Technical Consultants/Architects
+ Define and govern the overall data architecture strategy across Salesforce orgs, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with enterprise data standards
+ Own end\-to\-end data migration strategy and execution — covering discovery, profiling, cleansing, transformation, load, and validation
+ Advise clients on Salesforce object model best practices — standard vs. custom objects, relationships (lookup, master\-detail, polymorphic), and schema design
+ Lead decisions on data access patterns, sharing model, OWD, role hierarchy, and field\-level security as they relate to data architecture
+ Establish data governance frameworks, data ownership models, and data stewardship practices
+ Design solutions across multi\-org, multi\-cloud, and hybrid data environments

* You’ll have up to 15 direct reports under your scope of responsibility.
* You’ll be responsible for hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Consultants so they can implement successfully in turning the program design of our Solution Architects and Technical Architects into highest\-quality solutions that meets the customers’ needs, ensuring continuous team enablement across modern AI coding environments.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering model across your delivery team.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise\-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI elements securely, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Industries Cloud and Experience Cloud, guiding teams on the effective use of AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to maintain delivery speed and code health.
* Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by defining metric frameworks to measure the business value of client AI workloads.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third\-party stakeholders.
* Champion an AI\-first development workflow by utilizing advanced AI developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate Salesforce Field Service solution development, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, mobile application development, and integrations while maintaining platform security, performance, and Salesforce best practices.
* Practical fluency in using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems to maximize development productivity, optimize Field Service solutions, document custom implementations, and deliver secure, scalable, and high\-quality customer solutions.
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.


**Minimum Requirements**
* 10\-15 years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors, with a strong data focus.
* 5\+ years of people management experience.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.
* Proficiency with data integration tools (Informatica, Talend, or similar)
* Solid understanding of SQL, PL/SQL, SOQL, Python, data loading tools, and Salesforce governor limits.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud (formerly CDP)
* Expertise in one or multiples of → Sales/Service/Experience Cloud, Salesforce Industries Cloud (Comms, H\&I or FSC OR RCA/RCB) with a foundational familiarity with Agentforce architectures being a plus.
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Data360 and Agentblazer Legend
* Architectural Design Patterns
* Sharing and Visibility (Good to have)
* Platform Security (Good to have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security (Good to have)
* Proficiency in English.


**Preferred Requirements**
* Salesforce Certification Preferred (Admin, App Builder, Sales, and Service Clouds, Application Architect)
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, specifically keeping pace with AI\-assisted delivery trends and data compliance practices.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems.
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue.
* Strong interpersonal skills \- nurture effective working relationships with others.
* Exceptional analytical skills \- experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation metrics, and outcomes.

description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consulting groups specializing in public transport and mobility solutions. For over 65 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions develop by creating, improving and modernizing their transport infrastructure and systems.
   

  

 Context
   

  

 In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water \& Environment for public and private organizations.
   

  

 Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost\-effective and made\-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly.
   

  

 SYSTRA’s unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know\-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. We provide a comprehensive solution to manage all kinds of missions: Detailed Design Consultant, Project Management, Independent checking services.
   

  

 SYSTRA India’s comprehensive know\-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc.).

 Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation.
   

  

 Currently, we are bidding for Urban Planning projects across India. The position of Tranport Planner is the key position in these BIDs.

title: Sr Financial Systems Analyst
description:
HMH is a learning technology company committed to delivering connected solutions that engage learners, empower educators and improve student outcomes. As a leading provider of K–12 core curriculum, supplemental and intervention solutions, and professional learning services, HMH partners with educators and school districts to uncover solutions that unlock students’ potential and extend teachers’ capabilities.
   

  

 HMH serves more than 50 million students and 4 million educators in 150 countries. For more information, visit www.hmhco.com
   

  

 We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Sr Financial Systems Analyst within the FP\&A department with proven expertise in Power BI to lead data integration from Anaplan and other data sources, data transformation and modeling, and dashboarding. You will play a pivotal role in designing and implementing innovative solutions to drive financial performance and operational efficiency within our organization, while discovering new reporting and analysis to present to internal partners.
   

  

 Under the supervision of the Manager, Financial Systems, who is also responsible for the Anaplan tool within FP\&A, you will also perform administrative tasks within Anaplan related to data integrations, data validation, hierarchy management, etc.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Model Design and Optimization: Design, build, and optimize Power BI models to support complex financial analyses via self\-service access for our stakeholders
* Data Integration and Governance: Establish robust data integration processes to ensure seamless data flows between Power BI and other financial systems, while maintaining data integrity and governance standards.
* Performance Tuning and Scalability: Optimize Power BI performance and scalability by implementing best practices in model architecture, calculation logic, and data management techniques.
* User Training and Enablement: Provide comprehensive training and support to end\-users, empowering them to leverage Power BI effectively for decision\-making, analysis, and reporting purposes.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate closely with key stakeholders across Finance, IT, and Business Operations to gather requirements, define solutions, and drive alignment on Power BI implementation strategies. This can mean self\-identifying projects and presenting new, unanticipated, functionality within Power BI
* Continuous Improvement: Stay abreast of Power BI updates, industry trends, and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for process improvements, enhancements, and innovation.


**What You’ll Need**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Computer Science, or related field. Advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., Power BI certifications, Anaplan certifications, CMA) preferred.
* Proven experience using Power BI, with a strong track record of designing and implementing scalable Power BI solutions in complex organizational environments.
* Expertise in Power BI model building, including blueprinting, module design, formula creation, and dashboard development.
* Deep understanding of financial concepts and FP\&A processes, with the ability to translate business requirements into actionable Power BI solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail and a passion for driving data\-driven decision\-making.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams, manage multiple priorities, and drive projects to successful completion within defined timelines.
* Prior experience in consulting and/or leading projects is a plus.
* Experience in the education industry is a plus.


 The Information Technology organization is transforming to realize our mission: Become a leader in HMH’s digital transformation, and as a strategic partner, innovate and deliver highest value, competitive advantage solutions across all corporate and business functions. Our ambition is to be a digital leader through innovation and develop and deliver leading edge technology such as robotic process automation and artificial intelligence to solve some of HMH’s greatest operational business challenges. Our professionals will have business relevant skills to connect our HMH partners to technologies that propel the businesses to deliver the greatest value for HMH and our customers.
   

  

 We are building a team of IT professionals with an insatiable appetite to learn, a relentless focus on customer service, a technological curiosity toward future possibilities, and a creativity in solving business challenges with leading technologies. Our team will find ways to work together, create a sense of community where it’s safe to take risks and learn together, develop our careers, and all have an opportunity to work on new technologies. We will work together, learn together and have fun together. As a team, we will lead HMH’s digital transformation.

description:
**Company Overview**

**Position Description**
 We are looking for DataOps engineer with a hands\-on experience to automate our Databricks Jobs/Workflows, DLT, and SQL tasks, implement and operate Unity Catalog at scale.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Automation \& Orchestration (Jobs/Workflows \& CI/CD)
+ Design, build, and maintain Databricks Workflows/Jobs (multi‑task graphs, retries, triggers, alerts) for batch, and SQL workloads.
+ Implement CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps/GitLab): plan/apply for IaC, validate job JSON, environment promotion, approvals, and rollback.
+ Build templatized, parameterized job definitions (ingestion/batch/streaming/SQL) with standardized logging, notifications, and governance.
+ Enforce run‑as service principals, job versioning, change auditability, and artifact immutability.
+ Automate provisioning via Terraform (Databricks provider), Databricks SDK (Python/Go), and REST API 2\.1 for Jobs, DLT, Repos, SQL Warehouses, and Unity Catalog.

* Unity Catalog – Automation, Governance \& Migration
+ Catalog \& Schema Provisioning (Automation‑first): Idempotent creation of catalogs, schemas, default locations, owners, grants, volumes, storage credentials, and external locations using Terraform/SDK/REST.
+ Grant‑as‑Code: Standardize RBAC with templates (OWNERSHIP, USE CATALOG/SCHEMA, SELECT, MODIFY, CREATE, READ/WRITE FILES); integrate SCIM groups and service principals.
+ Security \& Audit: Dynamic views for row/column‑level security, data classification tags, audit logging, token policies, periodic permissions drift detection \& remediation.
+ Delta Sharing: Automate providers/recipients, share objects, and scheduled access reviews/expiry.
+ Unity Catalog Migration (HMS → UC or multi‑workspace to UC): discovery, wave planning, external/managed table registration, permission model migration, dual‑run validation (row counts, schema parity, query replay), cutover \& rollback.

* Reliability \& Data Quality
+ Define SLOs for pipeline success, latency, and data freshness; drive ≥99% T1 success and low MTTR.
+ Implement data quality checks (DLT expectations, dbt‑expectations/GX), idempotency, schema evolution strategy, checkpointing \& replay.
+ Build incident response playbooks; lead RCAs and preventative actions.


**Must Have Skills**
* 5–8\+ years (Senior) across DataOps for data platforms.
* Hands‑on Databricks: Workflows/Jobs, Delta Live Tables, Delta Lake, Repos, SQL Warehouses, cluster policies \& pools.
* Unity Catalog automation expertise: catalogs, schemas, volumes, external locations, storage credentials, grants, Delta Sharing, audit \& drift control.
* Terraform (Databricks provider) and Databricks SDK/CLI/REST for UC \+ platform automation; CI/CD with GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps/GitLab.
* Strong Python and SQL; Spark job configuration/tuning basics.

description:

*Where Growth Never Stops*
*At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company.*

Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business.*
*If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it —*
*Fuller is where that happens.*
 The
 **Process Optimization Team Lead** 
 is responsible for leading a global team of process optimization specialists focused on delivering and sustaining advanced process control (APC) and soft sensor solutions across customer sites worldwide.
   

  

 This role carries end\-to\-end accountability for ensuring that optimization systems continue to deliver measurable business value long after commissioning is completed. A key responsibility is the
 **proactive monitoring, review, and continuous improvement of APC and optimization performance during the months following project handover** 
 , ensuring customers achieve targeted process improvements, operational stability, and return on investment. Through ongoing performance management, customer engagement, and identification of optimization opportunities, the role drives customer success, service growth, and long\-term customer retention.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership \& Service Management**
* Lead and mentor a global team of APC and Process Optimization Engineers
* Establish performance objectives, technical development plans, and competency growth programs.
* Drive a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and customer\-centric service delivery.
* Conduct regular technical reviews, knowledge\-sharing sessions, and case reviews.
* Ensure service delivery processes support proactive customer engagement and value realization throughout the optimization lifecycle.
* Consolidated Status reporting (quarterly) of proactive optimization \+ PLA services on global sites of PXP applications to management teams (sales, engineering, development, PLA Project Managers).
* Collaborate with Engineering teams to implement improvements in proactive optimization \+ PLA service \& support activities for PXP applications to ensure sustainable long\-term benefits.


**APC Lifecycle Support \& Value Realization**
* Ensure reliable operation and lifecycle support of commissioned APC systems.
* Own the post\-commissioning performance management process, ensuring APC systems continue to deliver expected business outcomes.
* Proactively monitor APC health, controller performance, model accuracy, KPI achievement, and optimization effectiveness.
* Establish structured APC performance reviews during the first months following commissioning to identify improvement opportunities and maximize customer value realization by quantifying ROI/monetary savings achieved with High\-PXP utilization.
* Lead APC troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and performance recovery activities when deviations occur.
* Identify and implement continuous optimization opportunities that enhance process performance and customer benefits.
* Manage APC upgrades, migrations, and system modernization projects.


**Soft Sensor Deployment \& Maintenance**
* Design, implement, and maintain soft sensor applications for critical process variables.
* Develop inferential models using process knowledge, statistical methods, and machine learning techniques.
* Validate and continuously improve soft sensor accuracy.
* Support integration of soft sensors with APC and plant control systems.
* Monitor model performance and ensure sustained business value.


**Customer Success, Retention \& Proactive Service Growth**
* Develop and execute structured customer success plans following APC commissioning.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews, optimization assessments, and value realization workshops with customers.
* Proactively identify performance gaps, operational risks, and optimization opportunities before they impact customer outcomes.
* Demonstrate measurable customer value through KPI improvements and documented business benefits.
* Build trusted customer relationships through regular engagement and proactive performance management.
* Drive service agreement renewals, lifecycle support contracts, and follow\-on optimization opportunities.
* Support customer retention through continuous improvement initiatives and successful long\-term service delivery.
* Collaborate with sales and service teams to identify and develop proactive service growth opportunities.


**Experience**
**What you bring**
* 10\+ years of experience in industrial process optimization and APC.
* 5\+ years of experience leading technical teams as a technical lead.
* Experience supporting lifecycle services and customer\-facing operations.
* Proven experience in process industries Cement and mining.
* Knowledge in Machine Learning models, AI, and python programming skills will be an added advantage
* Knowledge in PLC programming, OPC, MQTT, SQL and System level troubleshooting skills will be an added advantage

title: Research Analyst - Market & Competitive Intelligence AI Enablement
description:
**Description and Requirements**
**"At BMC trust is not just a word \- it's a way of life!"** 
**Hybrid**
 Description and Requirements
   

  

 BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry\-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
   

  

 Business Unit
   

  

 The Sales Innovation, Growth and Market Acceleration (SIGMA) group partners with the Sales organization to improve seller productivity, strengthen customer engagement, and accelerate growth. This role supports two complementary priorities within SIGMA: AI\-enabled Market \& Competitive Intelligence and the operational execution of Digital Sales programs.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a strategic and execution\-oriented professional for a dual\-role position supporting Market \& Competitive Intelligence AI Enablement (50%) and Digital Sales PMO and Administration (50%).
   

  

 The successful candidate will help transform traditional market and competitive intelligence into an AI\-enabled function through Generative AI, Agentic AI, automation, intelligent research workflows, and Copilot\-based solutions. In parallel, the individual will provide PMO and operational support for Digital Sales programs, ensuring effective governance, coordination, reporting, process administration, and execution management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines hands\-on AI implementation experience with strong program management, stakeholder coordination, business operations, and administrative capabilities. The individual must be comfortable building and scaling AI capabilities while delivering disciplined operational execution across the two workstreams.
   

  

 Indicative role allocation: 50% MCI AI Enablement \| 50% Digital Sales PMO and Administration
   

  

**Primary Roles And Responsibilities**
 Market \& Competitive Intelligence AI Enablement (50%)
   

  

* Lead the adoption and operationalization of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and intelligent automation solutions across the Market \& Competitive Intelligence function.
* Design, build, deploy, administer, and continuously improve AI\-powered intelligence agents that support competitive intelligence, customer intelligence, market research, executive briefings, and knowledge discovery.
* Develop and manage AI\-enabled research workflows that integrate approved internal repositories, external data sources, analyst content, and enterprise knowledge assets.
* Create and optimize prompts, agent instructions, orchestration workflows, grounding strategies, and retrieval approaches to improve the quality, consistency, traceability, and reliability of AI\-generated outputs.
* Establish and apply AI governance, evaluation, risk\-management, responsible\-AI, and quality\-assurance processes to ensure trusted, compliant, source\-backed, and business\-ready intelligence deliverables.
* Partner with MCI and business stakeholders to identify, prioritize, prototype, and implement AI use cases that improve research productivity, insight generation, knowledge access, and decision support.
* Build and maintain AI knowledge repositories, prompt libraries, reusable agent components, templates, documentation, and best practices that enable scalable intelligence operations.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, models, and industry developments to identify opportunities or innovation and continuous improvement within the intelligence function.
* Define, measure, and report AI adoption, usage, output quality, productivity improvements, business outcomes, and operational effectiveness across supported initiatives.
* Develop AI\-driven reporting, automated intelligence updates, executive insight experiences, and self\-service knowledge\-delivery capabilities, while acting as a subject matter expert for Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI agents, prompt engineering, research automation, and intelligent workflow design.


 Digital Sales PMO and Administrative Support (50%)
   

  

* Provide PMO support for Digital Sales initiatives, including planning, scheduling, action tracking, dependency management, governance, and delivery coordination.
* Maintain project plans, roadmaps, milestone trackers, RACI matrices, risk and issue logs, decision records, and success metrics for assigned programs.
* Coordinate meetings and operating cadences, prepare agendas and pre\-reads, document decisions and actions, and follow up with owners to support timely closure.
* Coordinate global Digital Sales stakeholders and cross\-functional teams to maintain alignment, visibility, and execution against agreed priorities.
* Prepare and maintain dashboards, status reports, leadership updates, and other operational communications using accurate and current program data.
* Support process administration, documentation, knowledge repositories, intake and prioritization workflows, access requests, and other recurring operational activities.
* Track program risks, issues, dependencies, and change\-management or adoption activities, escalating items that require leadership attention.
* Support the administration and operational governance of Digital Sales tools and platforms, including user access, vendor coordination, license or usage tracking, adoption reporting, and issue follow\-through.


**Required Experience**
* 5\-8\+ years of relevant experience across AI enablement, business operations, market or competitive intelligence, research, consulting, PMO, program management, or related business functions.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with Generative AI platforms, AI agents, Copilot technologies, prompt engineering, retrieval and grounding approaches, research automation, or intelligent workflow solutions.
* Experience designing, implementing, administering, or supporting AI\-enabled business processes, agents, knowledge repositories, or research solutions.
* Experience establishing or applying AI governance, evaluation, responsible\-AI, quality\-assurance, and adoption practices in a business environment.
* At least 3 years of experience supporting enterprise programs, PMO activities, strategic initiatives, cross\-functional operations, or Digital Sales programs.
* Strong organizational and program\-coordination skills, including experience managing plans, schedules, actions, risks, dependencies, documentation, and recurring governance cadences.
* Experience creating executive reports, dashboards, presentations, operational metrics, and concise business communications.
* Experience coordinating senior stakeholders and global, cross\-functional teams across Sales, Digital Sales, Product Management, Pre\-Sales, Marketing, Strategy, or Technology functions.
* Ability to balance AI initiatives and operational workstreams, work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver consistently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 productivity and collaboration tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, confidentiality, and follow\-through.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification.
* PMP, Agile, Scrum, or related program\-management certification.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Power BI, or similar AI, automation, and analytics platforms.
* Experience supporting Digital Sales, sales operations, seller productivity, sales technology, or AI transformation programs.
* Exposure to enterprise software, automation, AI, cloud, data, infrastructure, workload automation, AIOps, observability, DevOps, or mainframe markets is desirable.

title: Sr. D&T Analyst – Data Foundations, Supply Chain
description:
**Company Overview**
 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Overview**
 Join our Data and Analytics organization to help digitally transform the Supply Chain at General Mills. As a Senior Data Analyst on the Supply Chain Data Foundations team, you will shape and advance our Supply Chain data ecosystem, building strong data foundations that enable smarter decisions, accelerate innovation, and create a sustainable competitive advantage. Blending technical expertise, analytical curiosity, and business partnership, you will work closely with Supply Chain leaders, technology peers, and global stakeholders to deliver scalable, high\-quality data solutions. You will serve as a technical data subject matter expert — guiding best practices, mentoring analysts, and ensuring our data products are governed, reliable, and impactful.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Partner with business SMEs, Solution Managers, and technology teams to understand Supply Chain data needs and align Data Foundations with enterprise Data \& Analytics strategy
* Translate business questions and requirements into clear technical specifications, delivery plans, and actionable data solutions
* Communicate timelines, priorities, and progress effectively to stakeholders to ensure alignment, transparency, and timely delivery
* Serve as a lead analyst and mentor, providing technical guidance, coaching, and oversight to analysts across the Supply Chain Data Foundations team
* Act as the Supply Chain data SME, partnering with engineers and architects to design, build, and maintain scalable, high\-quality data pipelines on Google Cloud Platform
* Maintain and enhance existing data foundations with a focus on performance, scalability, cost efficiency, and long\-term reliability
* Define and promote best practices in data analysis, modeling, documentation, data quality, governance, metadata, lineage, coding standards, and data security
* Use observability and monitoring tools such as Monte Carlo and Collibra to improve data reliability, consistency, and trustworthiness
* Drive innovation, automation, and AI enablement while strengthening analytical capability through knowledge\-sharing and peer learning initiatives
* Support strategic priorities including sustainability reporting, digital twins, predictive analytics, and regulatory compliance through strong data models and reliable pipelines


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Experience: 10\+ years of total IT/ITES experience, including at least 7 years in data analytics / data analysis roles.
* Technical Proficiency: Strong command of SQL (intermediate to advanced level) and hands\-on experience with ETL, data modeling, and data transformation tools.
* Analytical Skills: Proven ability to translate complex data into actionable insights that drive business decisions.
* Business Understanding: Exposure to Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or FMCG data domains preferred.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to simplify and present complex ideas effectively to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a global, cross\-functional, and multicultural environment.
* Delivery Approach: Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and collaborative delivery practices.
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Mindset: Positive, proactive, and self\-driven, with a strong sense of ownership and commitment to team success.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* FMCG / Supply Chain Exposure: Broad understanding of FMCG business processes — planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and sustainability — and how data enables business insights across these domains.
* ERP and Data Integration: Familiarity with SAP R/3, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW, and ETL tools, with an understanding of foundational data models and reporting frameworks used in enterprise supply chain analytics.
* Agile / Product Delivery: Experience delivering solutions in an Agile or Scrum environment, with a focus on iterative development, stakeholder feedback, and continuous improvement.
* Leadership and Mentoring: Demonstrated ability to coach and mentor junior analysts, facilitate peer reviews, and promote knowledge sharing across global teams.
* Stakeholder Management: Strong relationship management and collaboration skills, with proven success in working with business and technical leaders across regions.
* Analytical Innovation: Interest in exploring AI, GenAI, or automation to enhance data quality, analyst productivity, and insight generation.
* Academic and Professional Excellence: Strong academic background and continuous\-learner mindset, reflected through certifications, courses, or hands\-on learning in emerging data technologies.

 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Customer Success Data Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is seeking a highly analytical and customer\-focused
 **Customer Success Data Analyst** 
 to join the global Customer Success organization in India. This mid\-senior individual contributor role will support the Reuters Connect and Reuters News Agency portfolio, helping customers realize measurable value from Reuters editorial content, data feeds, and media services.
   

  

 The Customer Success Data Analyst will transform customer usage data, engagement signals, commercial information, and product health metrics into clear and actionable insights. This role goes beyond producing reports: it is responsible for identifying the story behind the data, diagnosing adoption and engagement challenges, surfacing commercial risks and opportunities, and enabling Customer Success and Sales teams to make informed retention and growth decisions.
   

  

 Reporting to the Director of Customer \& Sales Enablement, the successful candidate will partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Sales, Editorial, Product, Data, Sales Enablement, and Commercial Policy \& Operations teams. The role requires strong critical thinking, advanced business intelligence and reporting skills, data\-quality rigor, and the ability to communicate complex findings effectively to both internal stakeholders and clients.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own and enhance customer health scoring methodologies across the Reuters portfolio, including defining metrics, developing models, and identifying early churn\-risk indicators.
* Conduct in\-depth analysis of individual accounts and customer segments to diagnose declining engagement, adoption gaps, underutilization, and commercial risk.
* Segment customers based on health, usage trends, engagement trajectory, commercial value, and expansion potential to support Customer Success and Sales prioritization.
* Analyze customer usage, product adoption, engagement, and commercial data to identify retention and growth opportunities.
* Develop and deliver reports, dashboards, scorecards, and insight\-led narratives for Customer Success Managers, Sales teams, senior stakeholders, and clients.
* Translate customer data into clear and actionable recommendations that support renewals, retention, adoption, expansion, and customer value realization.
* Support Quarterly Business Reviews, Executive Business Reviews, renewal discussions, and customer meetings with tailored data\-driven insights.
* Help customers understand their content consumption and product\-usage patterns and demonstrate the business value of Reuters products and services.
* Identify trends, anomalies, data patterns, and commercial signals while applying critical thinking to validate findings before presenting conclusions.
* Support customer feedback, Voice of Customer, and customer\-sentiment analysis initiatives.
* Partner with the Data team to build, improve, and maintain scalable reporting and analytics infrastructure.
* Use Salesforce and related tools for reporting, dashboard development, data management, customer activity tracking, and commercial analysis.
* Ensure data quality across Customer Success reporting by identifying, investigating, and resolving inconsistencies in CRM, usage, engagement, and customer\-record data.
* Collaborate with internal data teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure reporting data is accurate, complete, and reliable.
* Incorporate AI\-enabled tools and automation into reporting and analysis workflows to improve efficiency, consistency, and analytical depth.
* Work independently in a global, matrixed environment while managing multiple priorities, stakeholder requests, and reporting deadlines.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Four to six years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, commercial analytics, customer success analytics, sales operations, or a related field.
* Experience working in a SaaS, B2B, technology, media, data services, subscription, or customer\-focused commercial environment.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including complex reporting, analysis, modeling, and presentation of findings.
* Strong hands\-on experience using Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence and data\-visualization platforms.
* Hands\-on Salesforce experience, including report creation, dashboard development, data management, activity tracking, and CRM data analysis.
* Demonstrated experience developing reports, dashboards, customer scorecards, analytical models, and recurring performance reporting.
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking ability, including the ability to interrogate assumptions, validate data, and identify actionable findings.
* Experience analyzing customer engagement, product usage, customer adoption, retention, and commercial performance data.
* High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and quality.
* Ability to identify data issues, investigate root causes, and work with relevant stakeholders to resolve them.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Proven ability to present complex data findings clearly and confidently to non\-technical audiences, including external clients.
* Strong collaboration, stakeholder\-management, planning, prioritization, organization, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively and independently in a globally distributed and matrixed organization.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience developing or improving customer health\-scoring frameworks, engagement models, churn\-risk models, or customer segmentation methodologies.
* Experience with Net Promoter Score, Voice of Customer, customer\-feedback programs, or customer\-sentiment analysis.
* Working knowledge of SQL and/or Python for data extraction, transformation, data cleansing, analysis, and reporting automation.
* Familiarity with Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight, Totango, or similar customer\-health and engagement tools.
* Experience supporting Quarterly Business Reviews, Executive Business Reviews, client renewals, account planning, or commercial growth discussions.
* Understanding of the news, media, publishing, information services, financial information, or B2B content industry.
* Experience analyzing how customers consume editorial content, data feeds, media products, or subscription\-based services.
* Experience using AI\-enabled tools for analytics, reporting automation, data analysis, or workflow improvement.
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and the ability to develop executive\-ready and client\-facing presentations.
* Experience partnering with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Editorial, Data, and Commercial Operations teams.


**What’s in it For You?**
* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2\-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future.

title: Senior SME Consolidation
description:
**Job Description**

**Role Summary**
  

 NIQ is seeking a Senior SME – Consolidations to partner with the Global Process Owner (GPO) in managing and continuously improving the global consolidation and close process.
   

  

 This role is instrumental in ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of NIQ’s consolidated financial results, embedding robust governance, automation, and process standardisation across regions.
   

  

 The Senior SME acts as the technical deputy to the GPO, providing operational oversight, subject\-matter guidance, and analytical insights across the consolidation lifecycle. The role will also contribute to NIQ’s broader R2R transformation agenda, supporting initiatives under Project Compass and RTR Quality Board.
   

  

  

  





**Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Consolidation and Reporting**
  

 • Lead execution of monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidations for NIQ entities in OneStream, ensuring accuracy and adherence to close timelines.
   

  

 • Validate consolidation entries, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation adjustments to ensure first\-time\-right financial results.
   

  

 • Partner with Corporate Accounting and Controllership to finalise management and statutory consolidation packs and ensure alignment of group reporting.
   

  

 • Support the GPO in monitoring Close Cockpit milestones and escalation management during close cycles.
   

  





**Governance and Standardisation**
  

 • Maintain and update process documentation, SOPs, and L4 process maps for the consolidation process.
   

  

 • Ensure consistency in consolidation methodologies, data mapping, and chart\-of\-accounts alignment across legal entities.
   

  

 • Support GPO in embedding internal controls (SOX) and ensuring full audit readiness across regions.
   

  

 • Perform process quality reviews and recommend corrective actions for control and reconciliation gaps.
   

  





**Technology and Automation**
  

 • Act as OneStream system SME, supporting configuration changes, system testing, and enhancement requests.
   

  

 • Partner with Enablement and IT to deliver automation and analytics initiatives (RPA, Power BI dashboards, consolidation exception reporting).
   

  

 • Develop and maintain standardised consolidation templates, mapping tables, and validation scripts.
   

  





**Business Partnering and Stakeholder Engagement**
  

 • Liaise with regional controllers, service delivery leads, and corporate accounting teams to ensure smooth consolidation execution and issue resolution.
   

  

 • Provide technical accounting and system support for mergers, acquisitions, and entity restructures.
   

  

 • Collaborate with FP\&A and Corporate Reporting teams to provide insights into consolidated P\&L, balance sheet, and cash flow results.
   

  





**Continuous Improvement and Capability Building**
  

 • Drive root\-cause analysis of consolidation issues and lead remediation actions.
   

  

 • Support GPO in developing and delivering training modules for RTR teams on consolidation best practices.
   

  

 • Contribute to process transformation projects aimed at shortening the close cycle and improving data accuracy.
   

  





**Required Skills and Attributes
   

  

 Core Skills**
  

 • Deep technical expertise in global consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and foreign currency translation.
   

  

 • Strong understanding of end\-to\-end RTR processes, including their interlinkages with FP\&A, Tax, and Controllership.
   

  

 • Hands\-on proficiency in OneStream, Hyperion, or equivalent EPM systems; good knowledge of SAP data structures and ledger logic (0L/1L).
   

  

 • In\-depth knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS, particularly consolidation accounting, equity method, and non\-controlling interests.
   

  

 • Proven experience in managing financial close governance, reconciliation frameworks, and control compliance.
   

  

 • Ability to interpret and communicate complex accounting and system issues clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

  

  





**Behavioural \& Leadership Skills (Modelled on GPO Capabilities)**
  

 • Process Excellence Mindset: Passion for continuous improvement, simplification, and first\-time\-right delivery.
   

  

 • Analytical Rigor: Ability to deep\-dive into data, identify anomalies, and provide actionable insights.
   

  

 • Influence Without Authority: Collaborates effectively across time zones, driving alignment without direct hierarchy.
   

  

 • Execution Discipline: Strong planning, prioritisation, and follow\-through to meet global close deadlines.
   

  

 • Change Agility: Comfortable working in a transformation environment with evolving systems and structures.
   

  

 • Stakeholder Stewardship: Builds trust with Controllers, SDLs, and Corporate Accounting through reliability and responsiveness.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

 • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
   

  

 • Professional qualification (CA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent) preferred.
   

  

 • 10–15 years of experience in Finance Operations, with at least 5 years in consolidation or group reporting.
   

  

 • Prior experience in global consolidation and reporting for multinational organisations is essential.
   

  

 • Exposure to OneStream or Hyperion implementations, process transformation, and automation initiatives desirable.
   

  





**Success Profile**
  

 • Operates as the technical backbone of NIQ’s global consolidation process.
   

  

 • Acts as the operational deputy to the GPO, ensuring process execution excellence and data integrity.
   

  

 • Demonstrates strong technical, analytical, and leadership maturity, preparing for future progression to process\-ownership roles.
   

  

 • Delivers accuracy, control, and speed — the three cornerstones of NIQ’s consolidation success.

* Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.

title: BI Analyst
description:
OneMagnify is an AI native, platform\-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity. We help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced analytics and artificial intelligence, we enable our clients to make better decisions, move faster, and compete more effectively in dynamic markets.
   

  

**The Impact You’ll Have:**
 We are hiring a BI Analyst to own the design, build and support of Power BI reporting for business teams across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Credit, Mobility, Connected Vehicle and Warranty. The majority of the work is hands\-on Power BI development on top of data in Google Cloud (BigQuery). You will work directly with business users to understand what they need, model the data properly, and deliver dashboards people actually use.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Build and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports and datasets end to end — requirement gathering, data model, DAX measures, visuals, publishing and support.
* Write and tune SQL in BigQuery to prepare clean, reliable datasets for reporting.
* Design star\-schema data models and reusable, certified datasets so business teams can self\-serve instead of asking for one\-off reports.
* Set up refresh schedules, gateways, workspaces, row\-level security and deployment pipelines; keep report performance and query cost under control.
* Build transformation pipelines in Dataform (or dbt\-style SQL models) and schedule them; use Cloud Run / Cloud Functions for lightweight automation where needed.
* Investigate data issues, trace them back to the source, and put basic data quality checks in place.
* Sit with business stakeholders, translate their questions into metric definitions and specs, and document what you build.
* Replace manual and Excel\-based reporting with automated solutions.
* Support Gen AI / Vertex AI use cases where useful — natural\-language Q\&A on datasets, automated summaries, Copilot features in Power BI.
* Review work from junior analysts and help them level up.


**What you’ll need:**
* 3–7 years of hands\-on BI / reporting experience, with the bulk of it in Power BI (Power Query, DAX, data modelling, Power BI Service administration)/ similar tools.
* Strong SQL — joins, aggregations, window functions, and the ability to debug a slow query.
* Practical experience with a cloud data warehouse. GCP BigQuery preferred; Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse / Fabric or Redshift equally considered.
* Working knowledge of ETL/ELT concepts and at least one transformation or workflow tool — Dataform, dbt, Alteryx, SAS, Dataflow or similar.
* Understanding of dimensional modelling and how to structure data for reporting rather than just extracting it.
* Ability to talk to non\-technical stakeholders, push back sensibly, and explain numbers clearly.
* A degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Statistics, Business Analytics or any quantitative field.


**Future\-Ready Skills (Nice to Have):**
* Python (pandas) for data prep or automation.
* Vertex AI, Gen AI / LLM\-assisted analytics, or Power BI Copilot exposure.
* Tableau, Qlik Sense or Looker experience alongside Power BI.
* Git / DevOps, CI\-CD for BI artefacts, Agile ways of working.
* Power Automate / Power Apps for workflow automation.
* Microsoft PL\-300 or Google Professional Data Engineer certification.
* Experience in integrated marketing, digital agency, marketing services, or consulting environments preferred.

title: Sr. Digital Analytics Lead
description:
Role Summary
 
 We are looking for a Digital Analytics / Adobe Experience Cloud professional with 8\+ years of strong hands\-on experience across Adobe Analytics, Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), Adobe Web SDK, Adobe Target, and modern data collection architecture. The resource should be capable of independently handling implementation, troubleshooting, solution design, migration, and day\-to\-day technical discussions with clients — moving beyond execution/support to take end\-to\-end ownership of Digital Analytics engagements, from requirement gathering and solution design through implementation, debugging, validation, migration, and client communication.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
 Implement, validate, and troubleshoot Adobe Analytics tracking — reporting, segmentation, calculated metrics, attribution, and analysis — using Adobe Tags/Launch for tag management and maintaining data quality, governance, and naming\-convention standards.
 



 Translate business requirements into analytics measurement frameworks, event taxonomies, data layers, and implementation specifications.
 



 Design and implement web events using Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK, including XDM event/schema design, Data streams, Edge Network, and Identity Service configuration.
 



 Own Adobe Analytics → Web SDK migration end\-to\-end: current\-state implementation assessment, mapping, migration planning, validation, and post\-migration troubleshooting.
 



 Manage core AEP components — XDM schemas, datasets, identities, data ingestion, and data flows — and troubleshoot data movement from source through AEP into CJA.
 



 Build and maintain Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) connections, data views, dimensions/metrics, calculated metrics, segmentation, and cross\-channel/customer journey reporting.
 



 Implement and support Adobe Target activities, audiences, offers, A/B and experience testing, and personalization/recommendations; integrate Target with Adobe Analytics and AEP/CJA for experimentation and measurement.
 



 Investigate and resolve data discrepancies across Adobe solutions using JavaScript, HTML/CSS, JSON, REST APIs, SQL, and browser developer tools/network logs.
 



 Define end\-to\-end data flows (Web → Web SDK → AEP → Analytics/CJA/Target), and produce technical design documents and implementation specifications, flagging integration risks and dependencies proactively.
 



 Lead client\-facing technical discussions, design reviews, and implementation walkthroughs; own requirement gathering and stakeholder management directly.
 



 Mentor junior/fresher resources and review their implementation work.
 



 Ready to work from office
 


 Required Qualifications
 
 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in Digital Analytics / Adobe Experience Cloud implementation, including Adobe Analytics (reporting, segmentation, calculated metrics, attribution, analysis) and Adobe Tags/Launch for tag management, with solid understanding of data layers, events, variables, rules, and tracking architecture.
 



 Working knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) — XDM schemas, datasets, identities, data ingestion/flows — and hands\-on Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) experience (connections, data views, dimensions/metrics, calculated metrics, segmentation, cross\-channel reporting), including identity\-stitching concepts.
 



 Strong hands\-on experience with Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK — XDM event structures, Datastreams, Edge Network, Identity Service — plus proven experience assessing, planning, and executing Adobe Analytics → Web SDK migrations.
 



 Hands\-on experience with Adobe Target implementation and configuration (activities, audiences, offers, A/B and experience testing, personalization, recommendations), including Target \+ Adobe Analytics/AEP/CJA integration for measurement.
 



 Good working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML/CSS, JSON, and REST APIs, plus working knowledge of SQL for data validation; strong troubleshooting ability using browser developer tools and network logs, and solid requirement\-gathering/stakeholder\-management and client communication skills.
 


 Preferred
 
 Knowledge of AEP Query Service / SQL for advanced data querying and analysis.
 



 Understanding of the differences between traditional Adobe Analytics implementation and modern Adobe Experience Platform architecture.
 



 Experience mentoring junior/fresher resources and reviewing their work.
 



 Basic understanding of Git / version control.
 


 Key Competency Areas
 
 Adobe Analytics \| AEP \| CJA \| Web SDK \| Adobe Tags \| XDM \| Datastreams \| Adobe Target \| JavaScript \| SQL \| APIs/JSON \| Analytics Architecture \| Implementation \& Debugging \| Client Management.

description:
SS\&C is a leading provider of mission\-critical, AI\-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS\&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid\-market firms, rely on SS\&C for expertise, scale, and technology.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Business Analyst – Role Profile**
**Role Purpose**
 The Senior Business Analyst works collaboratively across business and technology teams to analyse, design, and deliver process and system improvements. Operating within a hybrid transformation environment, the role plays a key part in defining requirements, optimising workflows, supporting intelligent automation initiatives, and ensuring high\-quality delivery through structured testing and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

 The role supports strategic transformation programmes across the business, including operational re\-engineering, service enhancement, capacity creation, automation delivery, and the adoption of AI\-powered solutions across the full trading and operational lifecycle.
   

  

 In addition to supporting AI and automation initiatives, the Business Analyst is expected to utilise AI\-enabled tools and techniques to accelerate business analysis, process discovery, requirements gathering, documentation production, testing activities and overall delivery execution while maintaining governance, quality and compliance standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Requirements \& Analysis**
* Engage with stakeholders to gather, analyse, validate and document business requirements.
* Produce clear and structured documentation including Process Design Documents (PDDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, business cases, use cases and process maps.
* Analyse current business processes to identify inefficiencies, risks and opportunities for optimisation, automation and AI adoption.
* Evaluate new technologies, automation opportunities and AI capabilities, ensuring strong business cases and measurable benefits.
* Act as the bridge between business teams, technology teams, data teams and operations functions.
* Leverage AI\-powered analysis tools to accelerate requirements gathering, documentation creation and impact assessments.
* Apply data\-driven analysis techniques to identify opportunities for process improvement and business value creation.


**Process \& Workflow Design**
* Own the definition and design of future\-state operating models and workflows.
* Model business processes using Business Optix or equivalent process modelling platforms.
* Facilitate workshops, interviews and discovery sessions with stakeholders across multiple business functions and locations.
* Ensure all process changes follow appropriate governance, change control and documentation standards.
* Take ownership of process and tool design on behalf of business stakeholders and secure approval.


**Automation, AI \& Agentic Capabilities**

* Elicit, document and validate requirements for Agentic AI solutions, including governance controls, escalation paths and human\-in\-the\-loop processes.

**UAT Ownership**

* Ensure defects are logged, triaged and resolved efficiently.

* Support automation testing initiatives and intelligent quality assurance practices.
* Establish traceability between requirements, testing activities and delivered outcomes.
* Provide clear reporting on quality, risks and production readiness.

* Develop strong relationships across Operations, Technology, Risk and Business functions.
* Support change adoption and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Coach stakeholders in identifying and prioritising automation and AI opportunities.
* Promote efficient use of AI\-enabled delivery tools within transformation projects.

* Strong requirements gathering, process analysis and documentation skills.
* Experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise or equivalent enterprise AI solutions.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated outputs and ensure quality and accuracy.

* Experience in process re\-engineering and continuous improvement.

**AI \& Automation Skills**
